opening_message:
Ticket 1: Donna Ball (employee ID E024) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E024.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin is only for the role that owns the system, so write is the maximum here. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB lists E024 as a contractor with basic training (HR note said full-time, but Security DB is authoritative for employment type). Contractors with basic training max out at read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend granting read.
reason: Security DB (authoritative for employment type) lists E024 as a contractor with basic security training. Contractors with basic training max out at read for Source Code (write requires advanced training). The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum of read is granted.

content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

The employee Donna Ball (E024) requests write access to Source Code.

HR note: role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
Security note: role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security says its DB is authoritative for employment type.

The policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Source Code is owned by Engineer role, so full-time Payroll Specialist max = write.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max read.

The conflict: employment type. HR says full-time, Security says contractor (authoritative). So employment type = contractor. Basic training → max read.

Requested write is above max read, so grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
